name: Paganella Ski
note: Andalo and Fai della Paganella, one ridge above the Brenta valley.
operationsProvenance: PLACEHOLDER. lastUp and queue are not from OpenStreetMap and are not yet from the resort either. They must be replaced with published lift hours before this resort is marked available.
defaultBaseWhy: The main village and the larger of the two lift bases.
toleranceWhy: Measured with npm run resort:tune. 75 is where the second valley connects: 14 of 15 lifts and 32 km against 7 lifts and 15 km at 60.
publishedSource: Paganella Ski's own published network figures, as recorded in src/resorts/index.js before this resort had data.
